ChatGPT answered 'Yes' and named five rival apps as best matches — ExpenseEasy, Mocy, Yavo, Breadsheet, MoneyMinder — plus Monarch Money, then offered to narrow by platform. The Sources panel showed 39 sources: each rival's own site, an App Store listing, apple.com, and two Reddit product-announcement posts ('Introducing: Receipt Scanning', Dec 2025). So for app questions a product's own site IS citable — the engine simply does not know AI Budget Assistant exists.
